description: This file defines the 'Details' feature within the 'Profiles' namespace, including a query class, validator, and handler for retrieving profile details based on a username.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents a request to fetch profile details by username, implementing IRequest for MediatR handling.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile detail request by invoking the profile reader to retrieve profile data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to fetch profile details asynchronously.
